input_policy: Complete original test and seven specified helper bodies equal01e6. All 37 input graphs retain two signed I64 constants, exact seed, internal key prefix, every arithmetic node, complete operand dependency, wrapping policy, return, function shape and original assertion scope. Mathematical goldens are static evidence and not a product run.

graph_shape.signature: Zero-argument I64 ENTRY, one block, original effect_mask1, two constants.
graph_shape.constants: Left is signed interpretation of seed*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 modulo2^64; right is signed interpretation of (seed|1)*0xd6e8feb86659fd93 modulo2^64.
graph_shape.arithmetic: Every actual arithmetic node has result_typeI64, two operands, immediate_kindU32/immediate1 (wrapping), cycling ADD/SUB/MUL from index0. First left operand is original left constant; all later left operands are previous actual result; each right operand is the same original right constant.
graph_shape.keys: Prefix forms both constant keys, value:left/value:right, every value:index, block and function. These are CoreIR construction keys; no Source declaration name, external export or module authority mutation is part of this original alpha test.
graph_shape.return: Return last actual arithmetic result (or initial left when count0 in general helper). Full opcode list is retained per graph; original test only requests positive counts.
graph_shape.allocation: Three original calloc buffers instructions(n+3), operands(max(n,1)), results(n+2); pointer admission CHECK, early failure frees every allocated buffer. Actual BUILD_OK CHECK then expected_out and full buffer cleanup. Not an injected-failure census or owning-object lifecycle proof.

independent_oracle_derivation.method: Closed modular expression independent of the original iterative C expected_bits branch.
independent_oracle_derivation.formula: Let L/R be unsigned constant bits, n=3q+r. ADD R then SUB R cancel modulo2^64; each completed triple multiplies by R. Final bits = L*(R^q mod2^64) + (R if r=1 else0), all modulo2^64. Interpret final bits as signed I64.
independent_oracle_derivation.separation: Preparation uses modular exponentiation and arbitrary-precision math, never executes the original builder/evaluator or reads expected_out. Independent review uses stepwise arbitrary-precision op simulation against fixed stored values. Neither is current VM/native/mixed execution.
independent_oracle_derivation.domain: Exact 64-bit modular arithmetic, including negative signed constants/results and wraparound; no host signed-overflow UB or arbitrary tolerance.
